Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Garth.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend Garth.
Resolve the Lightning Greaves equip ability, attaching it to Garth.

Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Donnie & April and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.

Resolve the second Aerith trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each legendary creature you control, thus removing the -1/-1 counters from Aerith and Derevi.
Resolve the Woe Strider abilities from steps 2 and 5.
Repeat.
997-1365-2608-6582.notes: The combo does not put +1/+1 counters on Derevi or Aerith, but does on any other legendary creature(s) you control.

Activate Conjurer's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, putting Temporal Manipulation onto the bottom of your library from your graveyard, and then causing you to draw Temporal Manipulation from the bottom of your library due to River Song.
Repeat each turn.
